title: Coast Guard rescues 6, searches for 2 after vessel sinks near Bahamas
description: A U.S. Coast Guard Air Station Miami MH-60 Jayhawk helicopter crew forward-deployed to Great Inagua rescues crew members from the sunken 90-foot schooner De Gallant approximately 20 miles north of Great Inagua, May 21, 2024. The rescue crew hoisted six mariners who had escaped their sinking vessel after a storm caused the vessel to take on water. (U.S. Coast Guard courtesy video)
